Container.Name: rampage-control
Container.Overview:
Monitors temperatures and controls fan headers and Aura lighting on the ASUS ROG Rampage V Edition 10. Fan duty is written through the NCT6791D hwmon driver. Lighting is sent to OpenRGB. Fan output stays disarmed until you turn it on in the dashboard.
On the host, load the sensor modules before starting the container: add nct6775, coretemp, drivetemp, i2c-dev, and i2c-i801 to /boot/config/go. The container must stay privileged with /sys and /dev mapped so it can read sensors and write PWM.

Config.Name: Host sysfs
Config.Description: Required. PWM and temperature files live here.

Config.Name: Host devices
Config.Description: Required for I2C and USB lighting controllers.

Config.Name: Unraid disks
Config.Description: Array temperatures. Spun-down disks are not woken.

Config.Name: Web token
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty on a trusted LAN. If set, the dashboard asks for this value.

Config.Name: Simulate hardware
Config.Description: Keep false on the server. true runs a fake NCT6791D for a preview.
